title: Development of Human-Agent Deliberation System
description: Developed a Human-Agent Deliberation system to explore human participation in cognitive human-agent exchange. This system supports different forms of human participation with timestamped logs for further analysis. It generalizes the recurring HCI system paradigm into a trackable research probe.

title: Development of an Intelligent Film Scoring Tool with Cross-Modal Perception
description: Developed an interactive AI system that maps multimodal video and music features to users’ subjective musical perceptions, enabling personalized and controllable film scoring. The system combines LLM-based semantic understanding, multimodal feature modeling, and interactive visualization to bridge objective media features with human creative preferences.

title: BioElectro Glove: AI-Assisted Mental Health Screening via Connective-Tissue Bioelectrical Signals
description: Participated in developing a non-invasive AI screening system for early depression risk assessment using bioelectrical signals collected from the fingers and palm. The system combines high-precision sensing with personalized decoding models to extract multidimensional physiological features and achieved an 83% identification accuracy in preliminary evaluation.
